diffs.diff: pin count: part has 8 (VCC GND SCL SDA Alert VBus Vin+ Vin-), datasheet reading has 7 (VCC GND SCL SDA Alert Vin+ Vin-)
diffs.evidence: The model is the Adafruit INA260 breakout (#4226), whose header has 8 pins. The Adafruit pinout page, under Other Pins, lists Vin+, Vin-, Alert and also: 'VBus is the bus voltage. By default it is tied to Vin+ however for low side measurements you should cut the VB jumper on the right side of the breakout and connect VBus to the power bus so it can accurately calculate the bus voltage and total power (VBus * Current) draw.' The second reading left out the VBus header pin. VBus also maps to the chip's VBUS pin in the TI datasheet.
